name: HB-2 LFS vLLM backend speed smoke
purpose: Add an OpenAI-compatible vLLM backend to the independent multi-state LFS runner, launch a small vLLM server on GPU4, verify endpoint readiness, and measure the same n=4 sudoku micro speed smoke against single-state and Transformers multi-state baselines. This is a backend speed smoke only, not an HB-2 result read.

code_added_used.change: Adds --backend vllm, OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions calls using urllib, concurrent request workers, and local-tokenizer per-row token accounting.
Adds detached vLLM server launcher with pid/log/env files and conservative GPU memory utilization defaults.

commands.purpose: Launch vLLM server for external-baseline speed smoke.
Verify vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint readiness and JSON response.

commands.command: python -m analysis.kvcache_lfs_multistate_baseline run-shard --backend vllm --openai-base-url http://127.0.0.1:8012/v1 --tasks sudoku --n-instances 4 --budget-scales 0.032 --state-batch-size 4 --request-workers 4
commands.purpose: Run vLLM-backed multi-state LFS micro speed smoke.

headline.endpoint: vLLM server on GPU4 responded to /models and returned a parseable JSON chat response.
headline.speed: Micro smoke wall-clock: single-state 79.943s, Transformers multi-state 28.451s, vLLM multi-state 9.698s. vLLM is about 8.2x faster than single-state and about 2.9x faster than Transformers multi-state on this micro setup.
headline.runner_elapsed: Runner-internal elapsed_seconds for vLLM was 4.532s; shell wall-clock 9.698s includes process startup/client overhead.
headline.accounting: vLLM rows stayed within budget_B=898 using local-tokenizer per-row debits: 319, 809, 821, and 839 tokens.
headline.formal_run: Formal x2 detached HB-2 run was left untouched and continued on GPUs 0-3.

gate_outcomes.number: GET /models and POST /chat/completions succeeded on http://127.0.0.1:8012/v1.
9.698s wall-clock vs 79.943s single-state and 28.451s Transformers multi-state.
No vLLM row exceeded budget_B=898; accounting uses local tokenizer input/output counts.
This is a micro speed smoke only, not a full-grid result.

decision.next_step_routing: Run a B*-only n=4 sudoku+graph_color vLLM sanity pilot before any n=64 interim. Keep vLLM backend results separate from direct-Transformers LFS results.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not provide HB-2 solve-rate evidence and does not replace the active formal run. It only validates vLLM backend feasibility and micro throughput.
honesty.scope_limit: n=4, sudoku only, 0.032x B*, and one vLLM server on GPU4. Larger budgets, graph_color, and futoshiki are untested for this backend.
honesty.backend_limit: vLLM continuous batching can change low-level deterministic outputs relative to direct Transformers. Results must be reported as backend=vllm_openai_compatible and not merged into direct-Transformers LFS rows without an explicit backend change decision.
honesty.external_process_note: The vLLM server uses GPU4 with conservative memory utilization and does not touch the formal HB-2 GPU0-3 run.
